sentences.text: A web page , or webpage , is a document that is suitable for the World Wide Web and web browsers .	World Wide Web	World Wide Web
A web browser displays a web page on a monitor or mobile device .	web browser	web browser	monitor	computer display	mobile device	mobile device

The web page is what displays , but the term also refers to a computer file , usually written in HTML or comparable markup language .	computer file	computer file	HTML	HTML	markup language	markup language

Web browsers coordinate the various web resource elements for the written web page , such as style sheets , scripts , and images , to present the web page .	web resource	web resource	style sheets	Cascading Style Sheets	scripts	client-side scripting

Typical web pages provide hypertext that includes a navigation bar or a sidebar menu to other web pages via hyperlinks , often referred to as links .	hypertext	hypertext	navigation bar	navigation bar	sidebar	Sidebar (computing)	menu	Menu (computing)
On a network , a web browser can retrieve a web page from a remote web server .	web browser	web browser	web server	web server

On a higher level , the web server may restrict access to only a private network such as a corporate intranet or it provides access to the World Wide Web .	World Wide Web	World Wide Web	web server	web server	intranet	intranet
On a lower level , the web browser uses the Hypertext Transfer Protocol -LRB- HTTP -RRB- to make such requests .	web browser	web browser	Hypertext Transfer Protocol	Hypertext Transfer Protocol

A static web page is delivered exactly as stored , as web content in the web server 's file system , while a dynamic web page is generated by a web application that is driven by server-side software or client-side scripting .	web server	web server	static web page	static web page	web content	web content	file system	file system	dynamic web page	dynamic web page	web application	web application	server-side software	server-side scripting	client	Client (computing)
Dynamic website pages help the browser -LRB- the client -RRB- to enhance the web page through user input to the server .	client	Client (computing)
